theme_strategy: Light mode default for optimal data readability, with functional high-contrast palette.

typography.instructions: Use Manrope for all headings (H1-H4) with tracking-tight. Use IBM Plex Sans for body text, ledgers, and tabular data as it provides excellent legibility for numbers.

colors.primary_brand: bg-orange-600 (#EA580C) - use for primary CTAs and active states

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use flat solid surfaces for data cards. 1px solid border (border-slate-200), NO heavy shadows to maintain a crisp SaaS look.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Subtle background shifts (hover:bg-slate-50) for table rows, slight lift (-translate-y-0.5) for summary cards.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use ONLY for sticky headers (backdrop-blur-md bg-white/80 border-b border-slate-200). Do not use transparent backgrounds.

component_name.tables: Shadcn Table - customize for dense data (py-2 padding). Right align currency columns.
component_name.badges: Shadcn Badge - use soft variants for statuses.
component_name.charts: Recharts or Shadcn Chart for margin/savings trends. Use solid minimal lines, no heavy gradients.
component_name.sidebar: Fixed left navigation with dark theme to contrast the main data area.
component_name.forms: Shadcn Input/Select. Use stacked labels, left-aligned.

grids.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6 for KPI strips.
grids.content: grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 where main content spans 2 cols, secondary panel 1 col.

layouts.overall: High Density Grid (Mode B). Left Sidebar + Top Header + Scrollable Content.
layouts.kpi_strip: Top row above tables showing 3-4 key metrics (Total Margin, Owed, etc.).
layouts.ledger_table: Task-first, progressive-disclosure. Show Date, Description, Amount (right-aligned), Status, and Action. Hide less critical data behind a 'View Details' modal.

motion.interactions: Micro-animations on hover (bg color shift, border color darken).
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions: transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets APCA/WCAG standards. Text over primary orange must be white. Avoid light gray text on white.
accessibility.focus: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:ring-offset-2 on all interactive elements.
accessibility.testing: All buttons, links, form inputs, and key data points MUST include data-testid (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

media.icons: Use lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboards.

3d_libraries.usage: Not recommended for this data-heavy admin dashboard. Focus on clean 2D charts (Recharts) for margins and savings.

image_urls.description: Goa street scene at sunset. Apply a heavy overlay (e.g., bg-slate-900/80) to ensure login form remains the focal point.
Modern white SUV. Use for car profiles in the owner ledger or booking engine.
Professional driver portrait. Use for the Agent/Driver Ledger.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts (@fontsource/manrope, @fontsource/ibm-plex-sans) and import them.
Implement role-based views strictly: Super Admin sees Margin/Cost Rate/Customer Rate. Operator sees ONLY Customer Rate (hide Margin completely).
Build the dashboard using a fixed dark sidebar (bg-slate-900) and a light content area (bg-slate-50).
Use Recharts for the Super Admin Total Margin Chart (Day/Week/Month).
For the Airport Transfer Tracker, implement a horizontal step-tracker or a Kanban board view (Scheduled -> En Route -> Completed).
For ledgers, use highly dense tables (py-2, text-sm). Align all INR (₹) amounts to the right.
Ensure all numbers are formatted as Indian Rupees (e.g., ₹ 1,500).
Add proper data-testid attributes to ALL interactive elements and key data cells for automated testing.
Create a clean login screen with the provided background image, an overlay, and a centered Shadcn card.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Keep layouts asymmetrical where appropriate to create visual tension, except in dense data tables where strict alignment is necessary.
Value negative space: do not cram elements. Use Tailwind spacing scale generously (p-6, p-8) for containers.
Content is king: The data is the most important part of this dashboard. Do not let UI chrome distract from ledgers and metrics.
Contrast: Use sharp 1px borders and distinct color blocks to separate sections instead of muddy drop shadows.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) ONLY for floating elements like sticky headers or modals.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, i.e., do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (sharp or pill-shaped) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like robot/brain etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, and entrance animations.
Use generous spacing (Tailwind p-4 to p-8) around major structural elements, but keep tables compact (p-2).
Use Shadcn components for complex interactions (dropdowns, calendars, dialogs).
Always use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder URLs (via.placeholder.com, placehold.it, etc.).
